chunks: And whatever is in it from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl al-Barmakī, I have narrated it from ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad ibn Mūsā; and Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad al-Sinānī; and al-Ḥusayn ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Aḥmad ibn Hishām al-Mukattib—may Allah be pleased with them—from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Kūfī, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl al-Barmakī.

key_terms.الْبَرْمَكِيِّ: The nisbah of Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl al-Barmakī, identifying the transmitter
key_terms.الْكُوفِيِّ: Attribution to Kūfah, identifying the narrator’s regional affiliation
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ: May Allah be pleased with them; a supplicatory honorific for the narrators
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s mode of narration

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl al-Barmakī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage records the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl al-Barmakī. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission in hadith sciences and preserving the route of authority for reports in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh.
